completion_meaning: All four ordinary-task engineering smoke samples and this independent numerical review completed; this is not a quality acceptance or an omni-generalization result.

evidence.method: Read-only remote JSON extraction and independent arithmetic on recorded per-sample metrics. No NPZ/pixel arrays downloaded or rerun; no jobs launched or changed.

scope.independence: The four degradation tasks and 22 adjacent frames share one source and target clip. They are not independent sources; no significance or generalization claim is made.
limitations: GT is the existing original-RGB proxy, not an independently verified pristine capture.
GT-proxy Farneback flow with the recorded in-bounds and forward/backward masks; identical support statistics do not verify pixelwise mask identity.
Adjacent-frame temporal error is a diagnostic, not a full perceptual flicker assessment.
H3/VAE uses the full 22-frame block; no streaming causality or cross-block consistency result.
The ComfyUI implementation's upstream Diffusers parity remains unvalidated.
No output images were visually reviewed in this numerical audit.

raw_guide_recipe.role: HR input guide; not the physical forward operator

contract.warm_start: same E(raw HR RGB) in both H3 calls; pretrained latent upscaler unused
contract.rphi_guide: clipped float32 export rgb; no uint8/MP4 intermediate
contract.anchor: clipped R_phi RGB; canonical Q4 SR, full RGB native
contract.anchor_stage: post-decode only; same generated output reused; no confidence weighting
contract.metric: eval_rphi RGB/LPIPS/flow on float32 clipped output, no prediction quantization
contract.future_frames: full 22-frame H3/VAE block; no whole-pipeline causality claim
contract.scope: development task observations; no clean-protection or frozen-test conclusion

factor_interpretation.guide: Only guide changes between the two generated calls; both use the same raw encoded warm draft, seed and schedule.
factor_interpretation.anchors: Both raw-H3 and Rphi-guided-H3 anchor arms anchor to the supplied R_phi RGB; raw_anchor does not mean anchoring to raw observation.
factor_interpretation.anchor_mode: Post-decode alpha=0.25; canonical Q4 anchor for SR and full-resolution R_phi RGB for native tasks. Same generated outputs are reused; no additional sampling, confidence gating, or physical measurement-consistency guarantee.
factor_interpretation.psnr_aggregation: Mean per-frame PSNR; psnr_from_mean_mse is separately preserved.

timing.interpretation: Recorded sampling is synchronized; sampling_decode includes CPU output materialization/checks. These are component timings, not complete end-to-end restoration latency. They exclude R_phi export, full guide preparation, post-decode CPU anchoring, metrics, saving and unrecorded setup. First-call timing is distinct from the seven subsequent calls; no real-time or streaming throughput claim.

findings.claim: R_phi guide substantially improves this denoise example relative to raw-guided H3, with fixed raw warm draft.
SR and deblur have modest PSNR/LPIPS gains from R_phi guide but slightly worse flow error; compression worsens in all three metrics.
Alpha 0.25 anchoring improves PSNR and flow error for all four tasks, but worsens deblur LPIPS for both raw-H3 and Rphi-guided-H3.
The final H3 R_phi+anchor arm remains substantially worse than R_phi-only on compression: all PSNR, LPIPS and flow metrics worsen. Do not hide this via cross-task averaging.
The final H3 R_phi+anchor arm has lower PSNR than R_phi-only on all four tasks; LPIPS improves on SR/deblur/denoise, while flow improves only on denoise. This is not uniform quality improvement.

Native-task anchor output has zero recorded clipped components. SR anchor output clips about 0.19% of components and slightly increases the Q4 residual relative to the preclip soft update; the correction remains soft, not exact consistency.

next_step.rationale: Compression over-restoration makes clean and near-clean harm the most discriminative immediate follow-up. Complete the fixed-parameter controls before considering an expanded ordinary dev run.
next_step.after_controls: Use controls plus this negative result to decide the scope of a multi-source fixed-parameter diagnostic; preserve input and R_phi-only baselines and both H3 guide arms. Do not claim that a favorable comparison between H3 arms establishes a gain over the original observations or R_phi-only.
next_step.not_automatic: No full-dev launch or acceptance is authorized by this review artifact itself.
